hooks.prompt: Check the server_info response for the 'update' field. Reply only with the JSON object {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "..."}. If 'update.updateAvailable' is true, reply {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} where the reason briefly says a newer version of the Roslyn MCP plugin is available (mention the current and latest versions) and suggests running /roslyn-mcp:update. If 'update.updateAvailable' is false and 'update.checkStatus' is 'succeeded', reply {"ok": true} and do not mention updates unless the user explicitly asked about update status. If 'update.updateAvailable' is null, null means availability is unknown: never claim that no update is available, and report 'update.checkStatus' if the user asked. For any other checkStatus availability is also unknown, so never claim that no update is available; if the user asked, report 'check pending' for pending or neverChecked, or the explicit failed or timedOut status. In every case other than an available update, reply {"ok": true}.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Roslyn apply done. Run compile_check (or build_workspace, validate_workspace, apply_with_verify) once at the end of the apply sequence, not after every apply."}}'
